sources.snippet: MoGe2Kit MoGe2Kit is an iOS 17+ Swift package for running the MoGe-2 ViT-B Core ML model on a single UIImage. It returns metric depth, an OpenCV-camera-space point map, normals, confidence, and the exact resized pixels used for inference. The included Xcode app is a working demo and 3D viewer; the package is the part intended for reuse in other apps.
